```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(flexdashboard)
library(plotly)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

data(instacart)

set.seed(8105)

sampled_orders =
  instacart |> 
  distinct(order_id) |> 
  slice_sample(n = 5000)

instacart_df =
  instacart |> 
  semi_join(sampled_orders, by = "order_id")

```

Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### What are people buying?
```{r}
instacart_df |> 
  count(department) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~department,
    y = ~n,
    type = "bar"
  )
```


Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### When are people shopping?
```{r}
instacart_df |> 
  distinct(order_id, order_dow, order_hour_of_day) |> 
  count(order_dow, order_hour_of_day) |> 
  mutate(
    day = factor(
      order_dow,
      levels = 0:6,
      labels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed",
                 "Thu", "Fri", "Sat")
    )
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_hour_of_day,
    y = ~n,
    color = ~day,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers",
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "Hour: %{x}:00",
      "<br>Orders: %{y}"
    )
  ) |> 
  layout(
    title = "Instacart Orders by Day and Hour",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Hour of Day",
      dtick = 2
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Number of Orders",
      rangemode = "tozero"
    ),
    legend = list(
      title = list(text = "Day of Week")
    )
  )
```

### Does basket size vary by days of the week?
```{r}
instacart_df |> 
  count(order_id, order_dow, name = "n_products") |> 
  mutate(
    order_dow = factor(
      order_dow,
      levels = 0:6,
      labels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed",
                 "Thu", "Fri", "Sat")
    )
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_dow,
    y = ~n_products,
    type = "box",
    color = ~order_dow
  ) |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Day of Week"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Products per Order"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```
